dedupe_keys.name: tm forum open apis rest api specifications for telecom resource service and product management

description: The TM Forum Open APIs are a family of about a hundred standard REST interface specifications that telecom operators and vendors use to exchange information about customers, products, services and network resources. They are produced by TM Forum, the telecom industry association, as part of its Open Digital Architecture, and mirrored for convenience in the tmforum-apis GitHub organisation, one repository per API. Coverage: global industry standards; examples relevant to infrastructure include TMF639 Resource Inventory, TMF638 Service Inventory, TMF634 Resource Catalog, TMF642 Alarm Management, TMF656 Service Problem Management and TMF673 Geographic Address. Each API ships an OpenAPI (Swagger) specification, a user guide, JSON schemas of the resources and conformance profiles. Format and access: OpenAPI JSON and YAML plus documents; the GitHub mirrors are public, while the authoritative directory on tmforum.org needs a free account for some material. Licence: Apache 2.0 for the mirrored API files. Caveats: the APIs define interfaces, not data, the GitHub copies are mirrors of the official versions, and operators implement subsets. Simulation uses: a standard schema for resource and service inventories and alarm feeds that a telecom digital twin or cascading failure model can consume. Related records: the TM Forum Information Framework (data-tm-forum-information-framework-sid) is the data model behind these APIs, and OpenConfig (data-openconfig-yang-models) covers the device layer below them.
